summary.headline: Q1 FY27 gross sales rose 5.7% to INR 641.2 crore while PAT jumped 51.7% to INR 15.7 crore on margin recovery.
summary.overview: Gross sales were INR 641.2 crore (up 5.7% YoY) and gross margin widened to 8.1% of gross sales from 6.8%, lifting gross margin INR 52 crore (up 26.5%). Operating EBITDA was INR 20.2 crore (up 27.7%) and PAT INR 15.7 crore (up 51.7%), helped by lower finance costs. Cybersecurity grew 8% and DCI grew about 180%, while ILM fell about 60% as customer budgets shifted toward GPU and data-centre spend. Management reiterated 20% growth in gross sales and PAT for FY27 and said H2 is seasonally stronger. The CEO is stepping down, with the Chairman/MD and Executive Director jointly overseeing the role.

segments.name: Cybersecurity
segments.commentary: Largest vertical at 44% of gross sales; grew 8% YoY. Management expects it to be about 45-50% of sales on an annualised basis.

segments.name: DCI (Data Centre Infrastructure)
segments.commentary: Grew about 180% YoY (management cited 186% in Q&A) and is the main growth driver; management expects DCI at 18-20% of FY27 revenue.

segments.name: ILM (application lifecycle management)
segments.commentary: Declined about 60% YoY as budgets moved to GPU and data-centre spend; management says it should normalise from Q3 on an annuity basis.

segments.name: Cloud
segments.commentary: Grew around 47% YoY along with ALM, per management (the transcript pairs the two; ILM is later described as falling).

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance of about 20% growth in both gross sales and PAT, with PAT growing faster than top line per CFO.
Management expects H2 to be seasonally stronger, with large deals concentrated in Q3 and Q4.
Q2 faces a hit from the annual appraisal cycle starting 1 July.
DCI expected at 18-20% of total revenue for the full year.
Annuity share expected to hold around 45-46%.
capex_capacity: No incremental capex planned for FY27 versus prior years; Centre of Excellence investment is in line with past years.
Management says supply-chain delays are about 1.5 months for its OEMs, far shorter than some peers' 7-8 months.
Geographic expansion started revenue in Vietnam, the Philippines and the Middle East; numbers still small.
Added about INR 300 crore to the pipeline in the last quarter; the company has 100+ OEM tie-ups and about 67 OEMs in its COE stack.
demand_pricing: Management says customers have prioritised budgets toward GPU and data-centre spend, which shifted demand away from ILM.
Top 15 OEMs contributed about 74% of gross sales; growth seen in more than 12 of them.
Win rate on the pipeline held at 30-35%; the INR 6,150 crore figure is a funnel, not an order book.
Hardware prices rose in parts of the portfolio; management says customers pushed back for discounts and volumes did not fall YoY.
Management guides to about 9-10% annual margins, dependent on value addition rather than vertical.

qa_highlights.question: Why did ILM fall about 60% YoY and is cybersecurity slowing versus peers growing 25-30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed ILM's fall to budgets reallocated to GPU and data-centre spend and expects ILM to return from Q3. It said cybersecurity is growing and is expected to be 45-50% of sales annualised.

qa_highlights.question: Why were Q1 gross sales soft and why has gross profit growth lagged guidance for several quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the FY26 base had a large GSTN deal of about INR 150 crore billed in Q2 and that large deals cluster in H2. It said the Q1 FY26 margin was depressed by rupee depreciation and low-margin deals, so a 10% gross profit growth in FY26 is not the steady-state rate.

qa_highlights.question: Does the 46% annuity share mean net new sales are weak?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said annuity was 43.1% in Q1 FY26 and that the roughly 3-point rise came from upsell and price increases at existing customers, not a hit to net new business.

qa_highlights.question: How does the company benefit from data-centre build-outs such as Reliance-Meta?
qa_highlights.answer: Krishna Raj Sharma said public data centres mostly contract directly with OEMs, so the larger opportunity is private/captive data centres. Sunil Pillai said the TAM will be sized once capacity is online.

qa_highlights.question: Will the CEO be replaced and is inorganic growth planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the CEO is leaving for personal reasons and that the Chairman/MD and Executive Director will jointly oversee the role, with new CBO, CRO and CTO appointed. Inorganic growth is being explored, with no material progress announced.

qa_highlights.question: Are OEM acquisitions by Palo Alto, Cisco or IBM a risk to accounts?
qa_highlights.answer: Sunil Pillai said consolidation has been ongoing for two to three years and that the company has not seen revenue loss from it, and may gain access to acquired products.

risks_watch: ILM decline (about 60% YoY) and whether it normalises from Q3 as management says.
Cybersecurity growth of 8% versus peers reportedly at 25-30%, and whether the 45-50% share target is met.
Gross profit growth (10% in FY26) versus the 20% guidance; the FY26 base is lumpy around large deals.
Q2 margin pressure from the appraisal cycle starting July 1.
CEO transition and leadership changes; three senior executives left recently.
Pipeline conversion (30-35%) and whether the INR 6,150 crore funnel converts to the 20% growth target.
Consolidation among OEMs (Palo Alto, Cisco, IBM acquisitions) and account retention.
Hardware price increases and discount pressure on margins.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the full-year 20% growth target and annuity stability, but evasive on ILM weakness, the CEO exit, and the INR 6,150 crore pipeline (described as a funnel, not an order book). Management repeatedly deferred quarterly questions to annual and H2 trends.
key_quotes: Though it was referred to as as an order book, it is just a pipeline, it's a funnel.
We believe that our focus on digital and hybrid multi-cloud offerings and expanding our partner ecosystem positions us well for this scale in the coming years.

adds.what: No incremental capex planned for FY27 versus prior years; Centre of Excellence investment in line with past years

growth.why: Management reaffirmed about 20% growth in gross sales and PAT for FY27, with H2 seasonally stronger and PAT growing faster than revenue, but no incremental capex or capacity is planned and Q1 gross sales grew only 5.7% with ILM down about 60%.
